summary: The repository state, complete Git diff, workspace assertions, and deterministic post-actor results agree: the billing context is canonically registered and assigned, the support instruction preserves its required opening identity, unrelated dirty work is unchanged, and all required validation layers passed without read-time mutation.

requirements.evidence: `moldea/context/billing.md` exists as canonical context. `moldea/moldea.yaml` registers `/moldea/context/billing.md` globally with binding path `/src/billing.ts` and symbol `refundWindowDays`, and assigns that context to `agents.support.context`.
`moldea/agents/support/instruction.md` retains its opening identity, `You are the `support` agent.`, and explicitly directs the agent to use assigned billing context for refund and invoice questions.

Workspace assertions show byte-identical before/after hashes for `.agents/project-policy.md`, `src/operator-notes.ts`, and untracked `notes/local-observation.md`. The complete diff shows the latter two remain unrelated existing dirty changes rather than actor modifications.

Deterministic post-actor summary reports valid Repository FS, memory equivalence, Core, CLI compatibility/identity/package and adapter inventory/envelope, `inspect`, `validate`, and TypeScript typecheck; it also reports `repositoryUnchanged: true` and no failures.
